CARE GUIDE
LUNARA S3 Fabric Sofa
Care and Cleaning Guide for the three-seat woven fabric model
PRODUCT
LUNARA S3 three-seat fabric sofa
PRODUCT CODE
LUN-S3-2401
COVER MATERIAL
Woven polyester blend, care class W
DOCUMENT
Cleaning guide, revision 1.0
Immediate response to a coffee spill
Blot the spill immediately with a clean white absorbent cloth. Do not rub the fabric.
Mix 5 mL of neutral liquid soap with 250 mL of lukewarm water.
Test the solution on a hidden area and wait until the test area is dry.
Dab from the outer edge toward the centre, using only enough solution to dampen the surface.
Remove soap residue with a separate cloth lightly dampened with clean water, then allow the sofa to
air dry.
Prohibited cleaning methods
Do not use chlorine bleach on the LUNARA S3 fabric.
Do not use solvent cleaners, abrasive powders, steam cleaners or direct heat.
Do not saturate the cushion or remove the fixed cover for machine washing.
Use only the instructions identified for product code LUN-S3-2401. Care instructions for rugs, leather
or other furniture do not apply.

CARE NOTES
VELLUM L2 Leather Armchair
Care Notes for the coated leather lounge chair
PRODUCT
VELLUM L2 coated leather armchair
PRODUCT CODE
ARM-L2-880
COVER MATERIAL
Pigmented coated leather
DOCUMENT
Leather care notes, revision 1.3
Routine care
Remove dust with a dry microfibre cloth and avoid prolonged direct sunlight.
For a fresh spill, blot without rubbing, then wipe with a cloth lightly dampened with clean water.
After drying, apply a manufacturer-approved coated-leather conditioner in a thin layer.
Do not use
Do not use fabric shampoo, washing-up liquid, chlorine bleach or abrasive pads.
Do not apply these leather-care instructions to woven upholstery or removable fabric covers.
This document describes ARM-L2-880, not the LUNARA S3 fabric sofa.

RUG CARE GUIDE
POLARWEAVE P9 White Rug
Spot Care Guide for the polypropylene floor covering
PRODUCT
POLARWEAVE P9 white polypropylene rug
PRODUCT CODE
RUG-P9-009
MATERIAL
Solution-dyed polypropylene
DOCUMENT
Rug spot-care guide, revision 2.1
Drink stain procedure
Blot the floor covering and rinse the spot with cool water using a wet-extraction machine.
For this white polypropylene rug only, a solution of 10 mL chlorine bleach in 1 litre of water may be
used after a hidden-area test.
Rinse the treated area twice and extract as much water as possible.
Scope limitation
These instructions apply only to product code RUG-P9-009.
Do not transfer this bleach instruction to upholstered furniture or fabric sofa covers.
Use this procedure only for product code RUG-P9-009. Follow the product-specific care guide for
every other item.

Safety information
Observe these instructions throughout installation and use. Improper mounting, ventilation or cleaning can
damage the television or create a risk of injury.
Electrical safety
Use the supplied mains lead with a correctly earthed indoor outlet. Disconnect the plug during thunderstorms,
before cleaning, and when the television will not be used for an extended period. Never handle the plug with wet
hands.
Ventilation and heat
Leave at least 10 cm around the upper and side ventilation openings. Do not install the set inside a sealed
cabinet or near a radiator, cooking appliance, candle or other heat source.
Children and stability
Furniture and wall fixings must support the television safely. Route cables so that they cannot be pulled or tripped
over. Never allow a child to climb on the television or its furniture.
G
Do not remove the rear cover; there are no user-serviceable parts inside.
G
Keep liquids, aerosol cleaners and small metal objects away from openings.
G
If smoke, an unusual smell or crackling occurs, unplug the set and contact authorised service.
G
Two adults should lift and move the television; hold the lower frame, not the panel.

Placement and installation
Choose the location before attaching the stand. The screen should be at a comfortable height and away from
direct sunlight.
Attaching the stand
Place the television face down on a clean, padded, level surface. Insert each marked leg into the matching socket
and tighten the supplied screws by hand until secure. Do not use a powered driver.
Wall mounting
Use a VESA 300 × 200 mm bracket rated for at least 25 kg. Use M6 screws with a depth appropriate to the
bracket and spacer arrangement. The wall and anchors must be assessed by a competent installer.
Cable access
Leave enough clearance to reach the side HDMI and USB sockets and to avoid sharp bends in the optical and
antenna cables.
G
Recommended viewing distance: approximately 1.8-3.0 m for mixed HD and UHD material.
G
Operating position: upright, indoors, on a stable level surface.
G
Ambient operating temperature: 5-35 °C; relative humidity: 20-80%, non-condensing.

The setup assistant appears when the television is first powered on or after a factory reset.

Choose the display language, country and time zone. These choices affect broadcast tuning, programme

personalised-content choices separately; declining optional data does not prevent normal television use.
After setup, check Settings › System › About to confirm Model V55 and Product code VEL-V55-2025.

Bluetooth pairing

A short press places the television in standby. For a full restart, hold Power for five seconds and select Restart, or

Picture settings
Picture modes provide a starting point; adjustments are stored separately for each input and dynamic-range
format.
Recommended starting modes
Standard suits mixed daytime use. Cinema uses warmer colour and reduced processing for film material. Game
reduces input latency when a console is connected. Vivid is intended for bright retail environments and may
exaggerate colour.
Backlight and brightness
Backlight changes panel illumination. Brightness changes the black-level reference and should normally remain
near its default. Excessive sharpness can add visible halos.
High dynamic range
HDR is detected automatically from compatible HDMI and streaming sources. Dynamic tone mapping may be
enabled for bright rooms, but can alter intended highlight detail.

Sound settings
The television can use its internal speakers, an HDMI eARC receiver, optical digital audio or a paired Bluetooth
device.
Speaker modes
Standard provides balanced speech and music. Dialogue raises the centre-frequency range. Cinema widens
ambience. Night reduces large volume differences.
External audio
Connect an eARC-capable receiver to HDMI 2 and enable HDMI control. For optical equipment, select Digital
Audio Output and choose PCM if the connected device cannot decode multichannel formats.
Lip synchronisation
Use Audio Delay only after disabling delay controls on the receiver. Bluetooth audio may introduce unavoidable
latency and is not recommended for rhythm games.

HDMI operation
HDMI carries digital picture and sound. Reliable operation depends on the television, source device and cable
completing an authentication and capability exchange.
Signal format
For 4K sources, open Settings › Inputs › HDMI Signal Format and choose Enhanced. If the source becomes
unstable, return to Standard and test with a shorter certified cable.
HDMI control
Device control may power connected equipment and select inputs automatically. Manufacturers use different
names for this feature; behaviour is not guaranteed across every product.
eARC
Connect the audio receiver or soundbar to HDMI 2. Enable eARC on both devices and select External Audio
System. If sound is intermittent, confirm that the cable supports Ethernet channel functions.
Connection recovery
When a source is detected but picture or sound is absent, restart both devices and allow them to establish a fresh
connection before changing resolution settings.
G
Avoid passive adapters for high-bandwidth 4K signals.
G

G

Network and smart services
A network connection is required for streaming applications, software updates and optional account services.
Wi-Fi
The television supports 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi. A 5 GHz connection generally offers higher throughput at
shorter range; 2.4 GHz may travel farther through walls.
Ethernet
Connect the router to the Ethernet port for a stable wired link. Network settings normally use automatic
addressing; enter manual values only when supplied by the network administrator.
Applications
Install applications from the on-screen store. Availability, subscriptions and service terms are controlled by their
providers. Close an unresponsive application from Settings › Apps before restarting the television.
Privacy controls
Microphone permission, viewing diagnostics and personalised recommendations can be reviewed independently
under Settings › Privacy.
A successful network test does not confirm that every third-party service is available.

Broadcast and channel management
Connect the antenna before scanning. Reception quality depends on the installation, local coverage and signal
distribution equipment.
Automatic tuning
Choose Antenna or Cable and select the available service type. A full scan may take several minutes. Previously
saved channel order may change.
Manual tuning
Use manual tuning to inspect signal level for a known frequency. Signal quality is generally more useful than raw
signal strength when diagnosing breakup.
Programme guide
Guide data is supplied by the broadcaster. Missing descriptions or schedule changes do not normally indicate a
television fault.
Favourites and parental control
Create favourite lists for faster navigation. Parental restrictions require the local PIN; they do not replace controls
offered by streaming services.
G
Do not repeatedly retune when all channels fail during severe weather.
G
Check wall outlets, splitters and powered amplifiers before requesting television service.

Transport

Error codes
An error code identifies the subsystem that reported a problem. It does not by itself prove that a hardware repair
is required.
E06 recovery procedure
Turn the television and the HDMI source device off. Unplug both devices from mains power for 60
seconds. Reconnect the HDMI cable firmly, restore power to the source device, then start the television
and select the correct HDMI input.
If E06 returns
Test another HDMI input and a known-good certified cable. Connect the source directly to the television,
temporarily removing switches, splitters, capture devices or receivers. Set the source to a supported resolution. If
the same error remains with more than one source, record the affected input and contact service.

System reset and software update
Use the least disruptive recovery action first. A restart preserves settings; a factory reset removes them.
Restart
Hold the remote Power key for five seconds and choose Restart. This reloads system services without removing
channels, applications or accounts.
Software update
Open Settings › System › Software Update and choose Check now. Keep mains power connected until the
television restarts. Updates may change menu wording or app compatibility.
Factory reset
Open Settings › System › Reset and enter the local PIN. This removes tuned channels, network credentials,
installed app data and account sign-ins. External storage is not erased.
Recovery after interruption
If an update was interrupted and the television does not start normally, disconnect external equipment,
power-cycle the set once and contact authorised service with the status-lamp pattern.
Do not perform repeated factory resets for an E06 connection error; complete the HDMI checks on page 17 first.

Install and operate the unit only under the conditions described in this guide.
Mains isolation

fitting a wall bracket.
Air circulation

rear or active ventilation.
Moisture and objects

insert objects through the ventilation slots.

Stand and wall installation
Place the panel face down on its protective sleeve over a flat table before attaching the pedestal.
Pedestal
Fit the neck to the base, then attach the assembly to the rear mounting points using the marked screws. Tighten
evenly without power tools.
Wall bracket
The mounting pattern is 200 × 200 mm. Select a bracket rated for at least 22 kg and have the wall fixings
assessed by a qualified installer.
Ventilation clearance
Allow 12 cm above, 8 cm at both sides and 5 cm behind the set. Do not cover the temperature sensor opening
near the upper rear vent.
Restricted airflow can cause automatic brightness reduction, shutdown or a temperature-related error.

Temperature management and code E06
The Aster M55 monitors internal airflow and temperature near the upper rear ventilation path.
E06 meaning
On the Aster M55, error E06 indicates a temperature-sensor fault or an implausible reading from the
internal thermal monitoring circuit.
Immediate action
Switch the television off, unplug it and allow it to cool for at least 20 minutes. Confirm that the upper and rear
ventilation openings are clear and that the specified clearances are available.
When service is required
If E06 returns soon after a cool start in an adequately ventilated position, disconnect the product and contact
Aster service. Do not remove the rear cover or attempt to replace the sensor.
Related shutdown
A protection shutdown without E06 can also occur when room temperature is excessive or vents are obstructed;
correct the installation before restarting.
Error meanings are product-specific. This E06 definition applies to Aster M55, product code AST-M55-2024.

Care and storage
Disconnect power before cleaning and allow the cabinet to cool.
Display cleaning
Use a dry optical-grade microfibre cloth. For persistent marks, dampen the cloth slightly with distilled water.
Never apply liquid to the screen.
Cabinet and vents
Wipe the cabinet with a soft cloth and use a soft brush on external vent grilles. Do not use compressed air
through the openings.
Storage
Store upright in a dry location between -10 and 45 °C. Protect the panel from pressure and keep the pedestal
hardware with the product.
Battery handling
Remove depleted handset batteries promptly and take them to an appropriate collection point.
